description: Defines functions and constants for MIME type sniffing, including logic to determine MIME types from content and URLs, and related configurations.

methods.name: ShouldSniffMimeType
methods.description: Decides whether to sniff a replacement MIME type based on URL and current MIME type.

methods.name: SniffMimeType
methods.description: Guesses MIME type from content bytes and URL, with optional HTML sniffing for file URLs.

methods.name: SniffMimeTypeFromLocalData
methods.description: Identifies MIME type solely from content bytes, using a broader set of media file signatures.

methods.name: LooksLikeBinary
methods.description: Checks if content contains control codes typical of binary data.
